title: SirBot
tagline: A Telegram crypto tipping bot for group chats. Makes distributing crypto tokens fun and easy in one of the biggest social apps.

description:
Telegram boasts over 700 million monthly active users and provides developers the ability to create mini apps and bots on its platform. Many crypto users are already familiar with Telegram, and some may have heard about Degen Token's rise to popularity on the Fracaster network.

Introducing SirBot, a crypto tipping bot designed for any Telegram chat. Users can easily tip each other by replying to messages with the format "n $token." SirBot will monitor and track all these replies. To start tipping, users need to register with the bot and connect their wallet. After receiving tips, users can claim their rewards periodically. SirBot efficiently tracks all balance changes, ensuring a smooth tipping experience.
how_its_made:
The project utilizes the following technologies:

- The Remix framework for JS/TS web development.
- Bun TS runtime for running a Telegram bot.
- Solidity smart contracts on all EVM chains. The smart contract is created with Hardhat.
- Worldcoin ID for user verification.
- Dynamic for authentication, onboarding, and user management.
